request.subject: CITY:GOBLIN:1

layers.text: Remove all ground: erase the brown soil slab under the camp, so the tents, the hut and the lookout pole stand directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under them. Keep the red patched tents, the grey scrap-iron hut, the lookout pole, the red flag, the outline and the art style exactly the same.
